text:
rachel: alerting: canary rollout v2026.05 started ~09:40 UTC but we're seeing batch of 500s from model-serving pods in us-central. logs show KMS decrypt failures at model init. looks like rotated key ARN is present in vault but the service principal doesn't have decrypt permission for the new key.
incident-bot: Paging on-call: @tom (pager)  severity P1. Incident channel created. Runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood/incident.
tom: acknowledged. rachel drop a couple raw logs and env dump please.
rachel: paste: ```2026-03-20T09:41:02Z ERROR model-init: decrypt error: KMSAccessDenied: user:svc-inference lacks kms:Decrypt on arn:aws:kms:...:key/rot-2026-03; env REDWOOD_KMS_KEY="arn:aws:kms:...:key/rot-2026-03" on 2/6 hosts, blank on 4/6```
ops-bot: CI job `deploy/inject-secrets` finished with warnings at 09:39:58 UTC. Job logs: https://ci.redwood/builds/7890.
meera: quick triage: we rotated KMS key in staging yesterday and updated the vault path to store new ARN KMS_KEY_ROTATED. inject-secrets template was changed to prefer KMS_KEY_ROTATED and drop the legacy REDWOOD_KMS_KEY during interpolation. older agent bootstrap still reads REDWOOD_KMS_KEY. net effect: some hosts got empty REDWOOD_KMS_KEY.
anita: mitigation options: 1) kill canary via feature flag 2) immediate backfill write to legacy secret name in vault 3) rollback canary to v2026.04. We should kill traffic first.
sam: I can flip feature flag now: `POST /api/flags/disable {"flag":"canary-v2026.05"}` -> 200. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Feature flag disabled. Routing off canary in ~25s.
tom: good. anita, push backfill and restart agents on canary hosts. watch for kubelet timeouts.
anita: executing: `vault kv put secret/redwood/canary REDWOOD_KMS_KEY="arn:aws:kms:...:key/rot-2026-03"` then `kubectl rollout restart ds/canary-agent -n prod`. Restart shows restart-succeeded on 3/6, 2 nodes stuck in CrashLoopBackOff referencing missing credentials error. investigating.
ops-bot: noticed network flapping on node-12 during restart; might be causing some restarts to hang.
meera: due to partial backfill some pods rejoined with correct env and started successfully; others still showing decrypt access denied because the IAM role on those nodes hasn't been granted the new key policy. this is a permissions propagation gap in the key rotation doc.
tom: we should also execute immediate rollback while we sort node-level permissions. sam, start rollback job for canary pool.
sam: rollback job started: rollback-2435678901-1 -> v2026.04. CI link: https://ci.redwood/rollbacks/2435678901-1.
support-bot: creating customer impact ticket: AIM-5678. Affected endpoints: /v1/embeddings and /v1/stream. Approx traffic: canary received 5% of EU+US write traffic; observed error rate peaked ~55% in canary. Estimated global customer impact ~2.3% between 09:41-09:44 UTC.
anita: after rollback and further backfill, error rate on canary host group dropped to baseline within ~120s. full recovery confirmed at 09:44:03 UTC.
tom: timeline for incident notes: deploy started 09:39:30, errors detected 09:41:00, feature flag disabled 09:41:20, backfill started 09:41:35, rollback kicked 09:42:00, recovery 09:44:03.
meera: immediate action items: 1) patch inject-secrets to write both REDWOOD_KMS_KEY and KMS_KEY_ROTATED for backward compatibility 2) add pre-deploy CI check validating env injection for agent versions back to 2025-12 3) add an alert when >1 host reports empty REDWOOD_KMS_KEY 4) update KMS rotation runbook to include permission propagation step. PR drafted: infra/ops#793.
rachel: drafting customer communications for support: short message stub ready. will send to support for review.
tom: handoff: I will be primary until 11:00 UTC for post-incident follow-ups. meera will own the pipeline fix. sam will validate rollback metrics and canary gating. please add further actions to INC-2026-243567.
meera: adding follow-ups in the ticket: - ensure vault has dual-key entries for 48h after rotation - run a canary in staging with older agent image - schedule retro to discuss release gating for config/schema changes.
tom: closing active mitigation thread here, converting to incident ticket for postmortem. thanks all. :bow:
